items.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler’s Digest
items.summary: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.

items.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
items.summary: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

items.title: Ethereum devs to narrow 66 proposals tied to Hegotá upgrade
items.summary: The Hegotá upgrade aims to introduce more native privacy for Ethereum applications.

items.title: JPMorgan cuts Polymarket banking ties over regulatory concerns: Report
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase reportedly cut banking ties with Polymarket in October 2025 over regulatory concerns but remains open to an underwriting role if the platform goes public.

items.title: The bitcoin futures market looks like a crowded club with a tiny exit – and it could cause pain
items.summary: The market may be facing a dangerous liquidity mismatch as futures open interest outpaces trading volume by a significant margin.

items.title: XRP traders bet on a rebound as price slips to $1 and bearish chatter surges
items.summary: Futures open interest climbed to $2.78 billion and traders on Binance and OKX leaned heavily long, even as social sentiment hit a three-month low.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $64,000 in Asia morning hours as HYPE jumps 8% on the week
items.summary: Every major gained on Sunday, though bitcoin, ether, XRP and solana are all lower over seven days.

items.title: Greenlane’s $70M BERA treasury ends Q2 valued at $16M
items.summary: Greenlane recorded a $19.1 million noncash valuation loss as BERA’s price fell nearly 76% year to date.

items.title: Chainalysis sues US over $95M ICE contract with TRM Labs
items.summary: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis’ specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.

items.title: The SEC meeting that wasn't: State of Crypto
items.summary: There were hopes that regulators could move if the Clarity Act didn't advance, but those, too, may be paused.

items.title: Crypto investors are looking past market-cap rankings and back to fundamentals
items.summary: Investors are starting to judge crypto tokens on usage, economics and value capture rather than market-cap rank, industry executives said.

items.title: Crypto wallet SafePal reveals a data breach exposing nearly 40,000 customers' order info
items.summary: While the data breach exposed the personal order details of thousands of customers, all private keys, seed phrases, and crypto assets remain completely safe.

items.title: MiCA's cleanup is creating a new scam wave across the European Union
items.summary: Fraudsters impersonating regulators and licensed crypto exchanges to steal funds from users forced to migrate their accounts after the EU's MiCA deadline are on the rise.

items.title: The stablecoin yield clash that won't go away has banks, crypto battling over tradition
items.summary: The bankers want people kept in lower-yield deposits for the good of the financial system as it's existed for generations, and their argument is gaining ground.

items.title: The 'long bitcoin, short the bankers' era is officially over as TradFi giants embrace digital assets
items.summary: Financial firms are partnering with specialists to build infrastructure, blurring lines between traditional and decentralized finance into a unified sector.

items.title: Robot maker Unitree is going public. Hyperliquid traders see 4x upside from IPO price
items.summary: Hyperliquid traders value Unitree at nearly $38 billion versus $9 billion at its IPO, leaving leveraged bets vulnerable when trading begins, Allium analysts said.

items.title: Swiss mega-bank UBS ramps up its Bitcoin exposure with a massive 24-fold surge in ETF call options
items.summary: Direct holdings of IBIT also rose 12% to 407,890 shares, while put option exposure dropped roughly 53% to 143,300 underlying shares during the quarter.

items.title: Why the world’s second-largest Bitcoin mining power is shutting down rigs in its capital city
items.summary: The Energy Ministry enacted the year-round restriction to mitigate power capacity shortages, as energy-intensive mining facilities continue to strain regional grids.

items.title: Paul Tudor Jones’ investment firm increases stake in BlackRock's bitcoin ETF after year of selling
items.summary: Calls fell 85.2% to 148,000 underlying shares, while puts slipped 1.4% to 715,000.

items.title: The $11.2 billion in 2026 funding that killed crypto’s permissionless era
items.summary: Dubai-based crypto lawyer Irina Heaver and her team parsed every crypto deal in the first half of 2026. BlackRock, Goldman, and Persian Gulf sovereigns all wrote checks to regulated firms.
